Security & Privacy

Security & Privacy apps for Omarchy

5 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-28 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 5 security & privacy packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-28.

Every security & privacy package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • 1password omarchy pkg add 1password
    The password manager and secrets vault that keeps every login, card, and passkey behind one master password.
  • 1password-beta omarchy pkg add 1password-beta
    The bleeding-edge preview channel of 1Password's password manager, ahead of the stable release.
  • 1password-cli omarchy pkg add 1password-cli
    Read, write, and script your 1Password vault straight from the terminal.
  • nordvpn-bin omarchy pkg add nordvpn-bin
    Encrypt and route your traffic through NordVPN's global network, right from the terminal.
  • ufw-docker omarchy pkg add ufw-docker
    Closes the hole Docker punches through your firewall.
